## OUTPUT FORMAT — deliverables must be authored as HTML
The owner's default output format is set to HTML. Any document, report, or final deliverable must be valid, self-contained HTML (semantic tags: <h1>/<h2>, <p>, <ul>/<li>, <strong>, <a href> …), NOT Markdown syntax. Write every HTML deliverable to a FILE — use the absolute path /golden/target/deliverables/<short-name>.html — and NEVER paste raw HTML source into a chat message or the closing summary. In the closing summary reference the file by its ABSOLUTE path. Plain, direct prose still beats decoration; this only fixes the markup language.
